name: WA Energy Assistance Payment
summary: A yearly credit on your WA electricity bill if you hold a Health Care Card or other concession card.
key: $334.49 of their energy bill each year.
who: Residential energy customer in WA holding a Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card or DVA Gold or Pensioner Concession Card.
how: Ask your electricity retailer (Synergy or Horizon Power) to add your concession card to your account.
catches: New accounts with a concession card also get a one-off $26.84 account establishment fee rebate.

evidence.quote: $334.49 of their energy bill each year
